accepted: Specialized Riverscape foliage shader, unchanged geometry and formulas. Per-record fixed shading is optional; front-to-back ordering rejected.

performance.note: Matched native desktop 4x MSAA, 24fps, muted; four-second warmup, 12-second CPU interval. GPU command timings include startup. No power inference.

ablations.note: Diagnostic shader ablations, deliberately wrong images. Deltas locate cost; they are not isolated pass timings. Native 4x MSAA, compact camera, 24fps; same geometry submission.

notes: Release and ASan/UBSan core tests passed. Native sanitized tap used ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 with Metal API Validation.
All production comparison cases use the same 4x MSAA count and dimensions. Exploratory ablations deliberately change shading and opacity, so their deltas are not additive isolated-pass timings.
Renderer comparisons keep the existing 8/255 maximum and .01/255 mean image bounds. Storage-only full RGB identity intentionally remains stricter.
